name: Getting A Job
overview: Scripture teaches that God sovereignly governs all things, including the provision of work and the assignment of roles, as seen in Jeremiah 27:5 where God declares He gives authority as He pleases. The call to use our God-given skills wisely is reflected in Exodus 35:10, encouraging the wise-hearted to fulfill God's commands diligently. Believers are reminded in Matthew 6:24 to serve God rather than wealth, emphasizing that our labor should honor Him. Seeking God's kingdom first, as Matthew 6:33 instructs, assures that our needs will be met, grounding the pursuit of employment in faithful dependence on God.
